website.description: Dalamud Plugin that shows information about player's mounts and it's acquisition methods
website.readmeExcerpt: # Dalamud Mount Search Plugin A Final Fantasy XIV Dalamud plugin that shows information about other players' mounts and their acquisition methods via the target's context menu button. To install the plugin, use the official [FFXIV QuickLauncher](https://github.com/goatcorp/FFXIVQuickLauncher) and download it from the `All Plugins` section. Note that [releases](https://github.com/megurte/WhichMount/releases) don't contain the latest version of the plugin. Check out [Dalamud plugins](https://github.com/goatcorp/DalamudPluginsD17/blob/main/stable/WhichMount/manifest.toml) for the latest one. ## Configuration The plugin has a configuration that is controlled by the Dalamud QL XIV environment. * Type `/mountsconfig` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window, or use the main Dalamud plugin window with the `Settings` button. Available options: * **Mount ID**: Shows game data mount id. * **Show Obtainable**: Indicates whether it is currently possible to obtain this mount in the game. * **Show Number of Seats**: Displays the number of people that can ride the mount. * **Has unique actions**: Shows if the mount has unique actions or not. * **Has unique BGM**: Shows if the mount has its own music or not. * **Added in patch**: Shows the patch that added the mount to the game. The plugin also includes a database view (`/mountlist`) that shows all mounts in the game, with search and sorting. ## Examples ![example1](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/68e0507a-dbeb-4213-8f48-3ea241f08efe) ![example2](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f5283f76-1da2-4ac2-b70a-257aca05d7f7)

variant.changelog:
Version 1.5.5:
  - New feature: click a mount icon to link it in chat - mounts with a whistle are linked as a native item link
  - New feature: 'Open in WhichMount' context menu entry on whistle and totem links in chat, opens the database with that mount
  - New feature: click a totem icon in the tracks tab to link the totem in chat
  - Mount name in 'Find Mount' chat output is now a clickable link
  - Improved totem tracking
  - Expansion filter in the mount database

Version 1.5.0:
  - New feature: tracking farmable mounts from trials and it's totems count on character
  - Fixed error on table tabs toggle
  - 7.51 patch mount data update

Version 1.4.2:
  - 7.5 patch mount data update
variant.description:
Shows information about mounts other players are using.

Features:
- 'Find Mount' in a player's context menu: shows their mount and how to get it.
- Mount name and unlock status in the target tooltip.
- Mount database with search, expansion filter and acquisition info.
- Trial mount tracks with totem counts (inventory, saddlebag, retainers).
- Chat links: click a mount or totem icon to link it in chat, jump back from any link via 'Open in WhichMount'.
